IF OBJECT_ID('D360.IBS_ADDRESSTBL') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE D360.IBS_ADDRESSTBL

CREATE TABLE D360.IBS_ADDRESSTBL (
    FCBS_Code   VARCHAR(10),
    FCBS_Desc   VARCHAR(30),
    CreditLens  VARCHAR(30),
    Valid       VARCHAR(20)
)

WITH (
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);
